profile: logistic activation: logistic activation, also known as the sigmoid function, is an activation function used in graph neural network prediction tasks. It is abbreviated as sig in formulas; for example, y = sig[βK + ωK(HK1/N)]. In a graph convolutional network training and optimization pipeline, the output is passed through a sigmoid or softmax function. The notation sig also appears at the start of a formula line in material on inductive/transductive learning and graph classification.
